name: Termination Without Cause or at Sole Discretion
patterns: (?i)(terminate|cancellation).{0,50}(without cause|for convenience|at its sole discretion|in its sole discretion|at any time without reason)
(?i)(at its sole discretion|in its sole discretion).{0,40}(terminate|cancel|end this agreement)
(?i)may terminate this agreement.{0,30}without having to state any reason
explanation: Allows termination without justifiable cause or at a single party's sole discretion, creating significant operational and commercial instability.

name: Short Notice Period (Under 15 Days)
explanation: Provides less than 15 days notice for termination, which gives inadequate lead time to mitigate damages, transition duties, or reallocate resources.

name: Liquidated Damages or Severe Penalties
explanation: Imposes predetermined liquidated damages or financial penalties that may be disproportionate to actual proven losses.

name: Automatic Renewal or Evergreen Clause
explanation: Automatically renews the agreement for additional terms unless opt-out notice is given within a strict window, risking unintentional lock-in.

name: Unlimited Liability or Exclusion of Liability Caps
explanation: Exposes the party to uncapped financial liability, excluding standard industry limits or liability caps.

name: Broad Indemnity ('Any and All Claims')
explanation: Requires sweeping defense and indemnification for 'any and all' claims, including claims stemming from third parties or non-negligent acts.

name: Unilateral Amendment or Modification
explanation: Grants one party sole discretion to alter contractual terms, service scopes, or pricing without mutual written agreement.

name: Non-Compete or Exclusivity Restriction
explanation: Restricts engaging in competitive business, marketing to other clients, or operating freely in the designated market.

name: Broad IP Assignment of All Work Product & Moral Rights
explanation: Forces broad, irrevocable transfer of intellectual property, including potential capture of background tools or pre-existing methodologies.

name: Non-Refundable Fees or Advance Payment Forfeiture
explanation: Bars any refund of fees or deposits, even if performance is delayed, disputed, or unilaterally terminated.

name: Payment Terms Over 60 Days
explanation: Extends payment settlement beyond 60 days (e.g. Net 75, Net 90, Net 120), negatively impacting liquidity and working capital.

name: Perpetual Confidentiality or Indefinite Survival
explanation: Enforces non-disclosure and trade secret restrictions forever without a reasonable sunset duration (typically 3 to 5 years).

name: One-Sided Jurisdiction or Foreign Arbitration
explanation: Subjects any litigation or dispute resolution to an inconvenient or disadvantageous forum, raising costs for enforcement.

name: Waiver of Jury Trial or Class Action Waiver
explanation: Requires giving up constitutional trial by jury or participating in consolidated class arbitration proceedings.

name: Unrestricted Data Processing or Broad Privacy Waiver
explanation: Grants rights to exploit, share, or monetize sensitive personal or operational data without explicit privacy compliance boundaries.

name: Excessive Late Payment Interest (> 1.5% Monthly or Compounding)
explanation: Imposes compounding interest or monthly late finance charges exceeding customary commercial limits.

name: Unreasonable Audit on Demand Without Prior Notice
explanation: Allows disruptive unannounced inspections or operational audits without reasonable business-hour notice.
